title: a-probe-resolves-its-owning-ticket-through-the-one-locator
author: CC (Opus 5), session a187d6ab
from_idea: none, because the finding was measured mid-voyage: CairnCommons/slates/2026-09-15-measurement-drains-the-review-lane-proved.json open_threads (a)
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the care of the code; cairn/tools/base and cairn/tools/chain are tools with users (Law 6).

decisions.text: owning_ticket resolves through grammar.ticket_path (lazy import inside the function) and re-derives nothing; None becomes the existing {unresolvable:<root>/<name>.json} hole.
decisions.by: derived from Law 1 and ticket_path's docstring ('the one implementation'); Akien 2026-09-15: 'we need to fix things that come up too. time to ticket those'

decisions.text: The hole contract (a string naming the path looked at, never None) is unchanged for all 92 call sites.
decisions.by: derived from probe.py owning_ticket's docstring (Law 7) — measured 92 live sites, 84 distinct names

decisions.text: ticket_path checks the literal <claim>.json file first, before _HEX_ID_RE and _TICKET_RE, so a full <id>-<slug> stem resolves regardless of its leading character.
decisions.by: derived from ticket_spellings (the stem is a spelling a ticket answers to) and measured: digit-leading stem 4431cf2bc625-... refused today, a-f-leading stems resolve by accident

decisions.text: The .json extension stays literal in this ticket; e78c9858f5fb changes it, now in one place.
decisions.by: derived from ticket e78c9858f5fb (records-of-truth-carry-one-extension-artifact, TICKETME:waiting) — its scope, not this one's

intention: A probe resolves its owning ticket through the one ticket locator, so a hex-id ticket's probe carries a path, not a hole, and the tickets lookup lives in one place.
why: Law 1: two implementations of 'where does a ticket live' is a re-derivation, and today they disagree (9 holes + 1 refusal over 84 names). Law 7: the hole stays visible. Serves e78c9858f5fb by leaving it one place to change.
how: cairn/tools/base/probe.py owning_ticket delegates to cairn.tools.chain.grammar.ticket_path(name, tickets_dir=root) via a lazy import; grammar.ticket_path moves its literal-file check ahead of the regex gates; a census tooth and a scratch-dir tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py and a stem tooth in cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_chain_grammar.py; both proofs resealed under the tester.
falsifier: DONE when, measured by a tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py that censuses every probes/*.py under the repo: for each literal owning_ticket argument, owning_ticket(name) and grammar.ticket_path(name) name the same file or both report nothing (0 disagreements; today 10 of 84 — 9 hex ids that hole while ticket_path resolves, 1 digit-leading stem that resolves while ticket_path refuses); a scratch tickets dir proves the three spellings (hex id, slug, <id>-<slug> stem) resolve through owning_ticket(tickets_root=) and a missing one still returns the {unresolvable:<path>} hole; grep -rn "*-" over probe.py finds no tickets glob (one implementation left, in grammar.py). WRONG INTENT if a live probe's carry needs a name the locator cannot serve (none in the census).
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel); Law 7 (errors loud at diagnostic surfaces); serves e78c9858f5fb.
watchme: none, because the falsifier is a census over the whole probe population and closes at PROVEME: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py re-runs that census on every reseal, so a probe added later with a name the locator cannot serve reds the seal at the next commit — the reseal ladder (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py) is the standing watch and nothing accumulates after rest that it would not see.

measured_at_cast.census: 84 distinct owning_ticket arguments over probes/*.py; owning_ticket holes 9 (299d4f72ae40 3ed960cc402e 3feb201c84ea 481221f45884 548dd13fb4db 7aed0fd0ba29 8e5db5f3edb2 eba8503cc18c fb988505c5cb), ticket_path resolves all 9; 1 disagreement the other way (4431cf2bc625-a-measured-seal-is-never-replaced-by-an-unrequested-one: owning_ticket resolves, ticket_path None); agree 74 / disagree 10 — instrument: scratchpad census_owning.py, to be berthed as the proof tooth

cast_checks.assumption_check: TWO. (1) That grammar.ticket_path is importable from inside cairn/tools/base without a cycle: grammar imports base.address (not base.probe) and orient.device_census; a lazy import inside owning_ticket is the standing pattern for exactly this (MEASURED: grep shows base/ never imports chain/ at module level today). (2) That ticket_path's tickets_dir override is the same injection as owning_ticket's tickets_root — both are a directory; the proof passes the scratch dir through both.
cast_checks.missing_check: ONE point was asserted wrapped and is not: ticket_path does not accept the full <id>-<slug> stem that one live probe passes (cairn/tools/... census hit 4431cf2bc625-a-measured-seal-...): a stem opening with a digit fails _TICKET_RE while one opening a-f resolves by accident. Recorded as decision 3 — the literal <claim>.json check moves ahead of both regex gates in ticket_path — rather than left as a regression the swap would introduce.
cast_checks.falsifier_check: DONE when, measured by a tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py that censuses every probes/*.py under the repo: for each literal owning_ticket argument, owning_ticket(name) and grammar.ticket_path(name) name the same file or both report nothing (0 disagreements; today 10 of 84 — 9 hex ids that hole while ticket_path resolves, 1 digit-leading stem that resolves while ticket_path refuses); a scratch tickets dir proves the three spellings (hex id, slug, <id>-<slug> stem) resolve through owning_ticket(tickets_root=) and a missing one still returns the {unresolvable:<path>} hole; grep -rn "*-" over probe.py finds no tickets glob (one implementation left, in grammar.py). WRONG INTENT if a live probe's carry needs a name the locator cannot serve (none in the census).
cast_checks.collision_check: Over the whys. Chain charter 'the one implementation, so a reader that OPENS a ticket and the gate that checks it is on file never disagree' — agrees; this ticket makes the last re-derivation ride it. probe.py docstring 'a missing ticket is a visible hole naming the path it looked at' (Law 7) — kept: None from the locator still becomes the hole string. e78c9858f5fb (.json -> .artifact) — a distinction: it changes the same lookup later, in one place after this. Law 6 — probe.py is a tool with users; no owner gate moves. No exclusive-and-terminal collision.
cast_checks.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: WHICH function changes — cairn/tools/base/probe.py owning_ticket, body only, signature and return contract unchanged. WHAT it calls — `from cairn.tools.chain.grammar import ticket_path` inside the function, `ticket_path(name, tickets_dir=str(root))`; None -> the existing hole string with the path it would have looked at (root/<name>.json). WHAT ELSE changes — grammar.ticket_path: move `filed = join(tickets_dir, claim + '.json'); if isfile(filed): return filed` to the top, before `_HEX_ID_RE`/`_TICKET_RE`, guarded only by `isinstance(claim, str)` and no path separator in claim. WHERE the proof goes — a census tooth and a scratch-dir tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py; the grammar stem tooth in cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_chain_grammar.py. HOW to seal — TesterDevice().run_proof(<path>, caller=..., isolation='netns') for both proofs, then commit. Nothing else is left implicit.

challenge_at_birth.better_approach: Considered deleting owning_ticket and having probes call ticket_path directly — no: 92 live call sites carry the hole contract (a string, never None) and the docstring's 'sender resolves once at fire time' is the ruled shape; the fix is one delegation, not a migration. Considered fixing only the glob direction — that keeps two implementations and leaves e78c9858f5fb two places to change.
challenge_at_birth.hidden_assumption: That the lazy import inside owning_ticket is cheap enough for a probe's fire path — ticket_path itself is two globs; the import cost is paid once per process. And that ticket_path's tickets_dir override is the same injection owning_ticket's tickets_root is (it is: both name a directory).
challenge_at_birth.prior_art: grammar.ticket_path (ticket watchme-emits-a-probe piece (d)) is the one implementation by its own docstring; ticket_spellings names the file stem as a spelling a ticket answers to; ticket 336a781018ba composed owning_ticket rather than reinventing it (19 probes then, 92 sites now). No ticket in the corpus names the hole (grep owning_ticket over tickets/: 2 hits, both citing it as a holding).
challenge_at_birth.real_collision: None. e78c9858f5fb (.json -> .artifact) changes the same lines later; this ticket makes that change one place instead of two, a distinction to record not a collision. The chain charter's 'the claim rides every link' is untouched.
